bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

events.title: Cash Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: Ticket sales from 7.15pm, eyes down 8pm. £5 a book, winner takes all. Over-18s only.

events.title: 'Bimble' car drive-out — Abbots Morton
events.body: An afternoon run out for classic and interesting cars, setting off from Abbots Morton from 12.45pm.

events.title: Glo-Quiz — The Lenches Club
events.body: The Club's live, hosted glow-in-the-dark quiz night. Gather a team and play for prizes. Children welcome.

events.title: Cricket: 2nd XI at home to Blockley
events.body: The 2nd XI host Blockley CC at The Lenches on Saturday afternoon, while the 1st XI travel to Stoneleigh. Spectators warmly welcome for village cricket in one of the county's most scenic settings.

events.title: Sounds of the 60s: The Nightingales — Lenches Amphitheatre
Mikron Theatre: Top of the Wold — Evesham
events.body: A touring company's new play about a mobile library, celebrating community and culture. From 2.30pm.

events.title: Evesham Scarecrow Festival — Hampton Ferry
events.body: Scarecrow-making, live music, stalls and the Rotary duck race, 10am–5pm.

events.title: Murder Mystery Night: Bingo! Bonkers! — The Vale Golf Club
events.body: A bingo night with a sinister twist, from 7pm.

events.title: Jeeves and Wooster: Stiff Upper Lip — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: Alfresco Actors perform Wodehouse's comedy. Gates 1pm, performance 2.30–4.40pm.

events.title: Inter-Generation Tennis Funday — Lenches Tennis Club
events.body: A fun, all-ages tennis day in memory of Rod Stroud, open to everyone — no club membership needed. Any two people with an age gap can pair up; barbecue, cakes, drinks and prizes, with the emphasis firmly on fun. To take part, email lenchestc@gmail.com.

events.title: Unmasked: The Magic of Angus Baskerville — The Lenches Club
events.body: Magic Circle magician and mentalist Angus Baskerville brings his hit show to the Club — jaw-dropping illusions, mind-reading and warm storytelling drawn from his own experience of autism and ADHD. 7.30–9pm, a show for all ages.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Encompass are also running children's tennis and multi-sport camps at the Tennis Club every Wednesday and Thursday through the school holidays. Further ahead: a free junior tennis taster session on 21 Aug (5.30pm); the Amphitheatre's free open-air cinema on 30 Aug (How to Train Your Dragon in the afternoon, Good Morning, Vietnam in the evening); and at the Club — private party 15 Aug, Cash Bingo 21 Aug and Glo Quiz 22 Aug.

news.title: Six weeks of roadworks at Pinvin
news.body: Main Street in Pinvin is closed until 28 August while the gas mains are upgraded — worth allowing extra time if you head that way towards Pershore or Worcester.

news.title: Cricket club: new players welcome
news.body: Players of all ages and abilities are wanted, whether experienced, returning or brand new. Contact Venky on 07442 772470 or Charlie on 07775 660065.

news.title: Fire crews praised after Harvington blaze
news.body: Firefighters have been thanked for their response after tackling a blaze at Harvington earlier this week.

news.title: Lenches ladies clinch tennis league title
news.body: The Lenches ladies' team have won Division 3 of the Evesham Summer League with a match still to play — a standout result for one of the league's smallest clubs. New players of all abilities are welcome; contact Joy Penzer on 07551 484114.

notices.title: ARCH Messenger deadline
notices.body: Copy for the next edition of the benefice magazine is due by Monday 10 August.

notices.title: Newsletter deadline
notices.body: Got something for next week? Send it to website@thelenches.org.uk by the end of Wednesday.
